meta.name: host-observer
meta.description: Use this when fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: reply only skip_summary or one full observation XML, never prose.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行Grok Bot的记忆观察任务,只输出标准总结或完整观测结果。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要让机器人按规范格式输出记忆观察结果。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a bot to report memory observations in a structured format.

howto.what: 承担 claude-mem observer 任务时,Claude 不再说普通的话术:没内容可记就只回 `<skip_summary>`,有内容就只回一条完整 `<observation>` XML(真实标题 + 4–10 条带路径的事实 + 叙述);随意写的长文会被丢弃。
howto.when: 执行 claude-mem 设在 Grok Bot 上的 observer 任务时触发。条件二选一:空闲/初始化/没有工具结果时输出 `<skip_summary>`;完成一个可搜索单元时输出带事实的 `<observation>`。

say.text: 这一轮没有值得记的内容,直接回 skip_summary 吧。
把这次修好的 bug 写成 observation,事实给出路径。
say.note: 产出一条 `<observation>`;标题不得用工具名。

howto.what_en: Under claude-mem observer jobs, Claude replies with `<skip_summary>` when nothing is worth recording, or a full `<observation>` XML (real title, 4–10 path-backed facts, narrative; types such as bugfix/feature/refactor/change/discovery/decision). Prose never appears.
howto.when_en: Triggered while fulfilling claude-mem observer jobs on Grok Bot: on idle/init/no tool results Claude replies `<skip_summary>`; once a searchable unit is finished, it replies with a full `<observation>`.

say_en.text: Nothing worth recording this round—just return skip_summary.
Write this fixed bug as an observation, and give file paths as facts.
say_en.note: Emits an `<observation>`; the title must not be a tool name.

say_en.text: Don't answer in prose—output skip_summary or observation as XML.
say_en.note: Prose is dropped, so those two XML forms are the only valid reply.
